name: ModelVariant665_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant665_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (rings of shaded strips fly out of the slot while quads rise from model points, sparks fall, a burst quad flashes and fans of strips spin, with the ambient light fading down and back); a non-negative request prints the work size and sets up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-682/749 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant682_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, without the work-size printf and its string, and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
